card.name: Inside digoxin and digitalis names
card.fires_on: The middle or ending piece of digitalis-family drug words, such as the 'ox' in Digoxin and the 'ize' or 'is' in digitalize and digitalis. It appears in label text on heart glycosides.

modes.label: Digoxin middle
modes.description: The 'ox' piece after 'Dig' when the drug name digoxin is split up.

modes.label: Digitalis endings
modes.description: The ending piece of digitalis or digitalize after 'Digital'.
